CREATE_PROJECT_INFO:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_info (
            uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            dcim_path TEXT NOT NULL,
            dcim_linked INTEGER NOT NULL,
            version_major INTEGER NOT NULL,
            version_mid INTEGER NOT NULL,
            version_minor INTEGER NOT NULL
        );
CREATE_VIDEOS:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS videos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            frontThumbnail TEXT NOT NULL,
            backThumbnail TEXT NOT NULL,
            format_name TEXT NOT NULL,
            format_firmware TEXT NOT NULL,
            format_height INTEGER NOT NULL,
            format_width INTEGER NOT NULL,
            format_fps REAL NOT NULL
        );
CREATE_SEGMENTS:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS segments (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            vid INTEGER NOT NULL,
            frontMP4 TEXT NOT NULL,
            frontLRV TEXT NOT NULL,
            backMP4 TEXT NOT NULL,
            backLRV TEXT NOT NULL,
            backWAV TEXT NOT NULL,
            FOREIGN KEY(vid) REFERENCES videos(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
        );
UPDATE_PROJECT_INFO:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO project_info
            (uuid, name, dcim_path, dcim_linked, version_major, version_mid, version_minor)
        VALUES
            (:uuid, :name, :dcim_path, :dcim_linked, :version_major, :version_mid, :version_minor)
        ;
UPDATE_VIDEO:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO videos
            (id, name, frontThumbnail, backThumbnail, format_name, format_firmware,
            format_height, format_width, format_fps)
        VALUES
            (:id, :name, :frontThumbnail, :backThumbnail, :format_name, :format_firmware,
            :format_height, :format_width, :format_fps)
        ;
UPDATE_SEGMENT:
INSERT OR REPLACE INTO segments
            (id, vid, frontMP4, frontLRV, backMP4, backLRV, backWAV)
        VALUES
            (:id, :vid, :frontMP4, :frontLRV, :backMP4, :backLRV, :backWAV)
        ;
